item.title: Pokémon Go Minior Shower schedule
item.description: The meteor Pokémon, Minior , is making its Pokémon Go debut with its many colorful cores, but it'll only be available during real-life meteor showers. You'll want to keep your eyes peeled for these little critters during these rare moments throughout the year, and keep an extra watchful eye in the evening, as these will appear more frequently. To assist with this, we've put together a Minior schedule, so you know exactly when to look out for these.

item.title: 5 Years Later, One Game’s Blood Sacrifice Mechanic Still Haunts Me
item.description: Typically, when you’re playing a card game, the stakes aren’t that high. Perhaps you’ve got some money on the line. Maybe bragging rights are on the table. But even if you lose, largely speaking, things are going to be fine. Not so in 2021’s Inscryption , a deckbuilder horror game developed by Daniel Mullins Games and published by Devolver Digital, that starts with a haunted card game in a creepy cabin in the woods. But before long, you’ll be eyeing a pair of pliers and wondering which parts of your own body you can live without.

item.title: Tim Burton's 77-Minute Stop-Motion Masterpiece Is Officially Back on Streaming
item.description: When it comes to beautiful, high-quality stop-motion animation, independent studio Laika is the first name that comes to mind. The studio’s hand-crafted puppetry and 3D-printing technology have brought beautiful tales to life for years, from Coraline to ParaNorman . Each has leaned toward more adult themes with gothic narrative undertones, while still focusing heavily on family dynamics. The same is true of Laika’s most recent outing, Travis Knight’s ethereal fantasy film Wildwood .

item.title: True Detective Season 5 to feature the best starring duo since Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson
item.description: True Detective fans just got some exciting news: two of the main cast members and the setting of the show's fifth season have been revealed. The casting announcements are especially exciting, as it has been confirmed that Nicolas Cage and Antonio Banderas will star as the headlining duo in Season 5.

item.title: US Representative Introduces Plan To Preserve Digital Game Ownership
item.description: United States Representative Ritchie Torres will introduce the Power To The Players Act . This legislation is being made to support consumers' rights in a way that grants gamers ownership of their digital games. If successful, the Federal Trade Commission could then establish regulations to prevent companies from delisting games, shutting down servers early in a game's life, and easily revoking digital licenses.

item.title: 22 Years Ago, One Perfect Twist Changed TV's Greatest Sci-Fi Series Forever
item.description: At the time, Lindelof was discussing his new series, Lost — which just four episodes in, had pulled off a mind-blowing twist arguably on the same level as The Sixth Sense . For its first few episodes, Lost seems like an ambitious survival drama with a dash of horror. Oceanic Flight 815 crashes on a seemingly deserted tropical island. Its survivors contend with dwindling supplies, a rampaging monster, an inexplicable polar bear, and the unfortunate realization that rescuers are probably searching a thousand miles away from where they actually crashed.

item.title: Star Wars Zero Company Finally Makes Starting A New Campaign Worth It
item.description: I've been waiting for a reason to start a new playthrough of Star Wars Zero Company ever since I beat the game in early September. EA and Bit Reactor have finally given me a reason to come back to the game, as Patch 1.2 added a lot of new gameplay settings that will allow me to tweak my next playthrough's difficulty to my liking.
